project_type: Next.js 16.4.0 standalone app with FastAPI backend, TypeScript monorepo
build_system: npm + Next.js build system, Tailwind CSS v4, Turbopack for dev
test_framework: No frontend tests found, uses Next.js build for verification
test_command: cd apps/web && npm run build (no separate test command found)
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build to check for TypeScript errors. 2. Check browser preview for visual changes. 3. Verify API endpoints work with sessionStorage token. 4. Ensure mobile responsiveness.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Next.js build generates .next/ directory. No generated files need to be committed.
environment_constraints: Must use existing CSS variables from globals.css. Font: Arial only. Colors: use --ink (#0f1215), --color-bg (#f4f2ec), --color-primary (#0a7a5a), --mint (#3fd3a0). API rewrites defined in next.config.ts to https://tood-os-api-844874461521.europe-west2.run.app.
contribution_requirements: From AGENTS.md: Never push to main, work on branch. Never use plain SET for tenant context. Never commit secrets. Human review required for authentication changes. Commit message ends with 'Agent: wf-coder'.
key_patterns: 1. Components are functional with TypeScript interfaces. 2. Uses CSS variables from globals.css. 3. API calls use fetch with Authorization: Bearer token from sessionStorage. 4. Dark/light theme via data-theme attribute. 5. Mobile-first responsive design with wrap container pattern.
directory_structure: apps/web/ - Next.js frontend. app/ - App router pages. public/ - Static assets. packages/ui, packages/api-client, workers/ - Shared packages. apps/api/ - FastAPI backend. docs/, rules/, prompts/, migrations/, infra/, security/ - Backend and configuration.
